Senses.Explanation: A doubled call-out of age and standing, aimed at elders who should know better. Dongshan Liangjie tells his dharma-uncle that so old and great a man should not speak of a white rabbit like a commoner made minister, Yunju Daoying asks the wandering Zhaozhou why, so old and great, he has not found a place to settle, Dahui Zonggao adds twenty strokes to Xuefeng's own twenty for answering in another's mouth, since one so old and great should not have spoken for the monk, and Tianyin Yuanxiu answers the stone-tower and layman Pang exchange by calling the layman too old and great to still read it that way. Poshan Haiming brushes off a question on the non-abiding mind by asking how one so old and great can still talk like this, Liangting Jingting rules that the sick old master misspoke to say someone might come see him, and Guantao Daqi grades Nanquan and Huangbo as two grand old men hindering each other.
